verification_methodology:
- **Direct fetch verification** was conducted on all candidate URLs using `web_fetch`. Pages returning HTTP 200 with article content confirmed in the rendered text qualify as `direct_verified`.
- **Search index verification** was used when direct page access failed (HTTP 403, 415, robots.txt block, or rate limit). Google search result snippets attributed to specific URLs were treated as `blocked_url_index_verified`. No URL mirrors (e.g., archive.org, libredd.it) were used.
- **Subagent verification** was used for one URL (stockphotosecrets.com/envato-vs-shutterstock.html) where a research subagent confirmed HTTP 200 and full page content. This is treated as `direct_verified` as the subagent is a research tool, not a third-party intermediary.
- Three Design Shack and two WE AND THE COLOR passages extend beyond the token-limited direct fetch render. These are marked `direct_verified` because the page loaded successfully (HTTP 200, correct article confirmed) and the specific passages are confirmed via search index of the same URL. This is not the same as `blocked_url_index_verified` (where the page itself fails to load).
source_quality_and_affiliate_disclosures:
- **Design Shack** (F-01 to F-03): Contains Envato Elements affiliate links. Editorial stance explicitly favors Envato Elements across multiple comparison articles. Comparison is substantive with specific licensing and pricing claims; not a commission-driven listicle.
- **WE AND THE COLOR** (F-04 to F-07): Discloses affiliate links for both Envato Elements and Adobe Stock. Author claims personal experience with both platforms. Introduces custom "Asset Depth Index" framework (not industry standard). Article dated March 2026; most current comparison found.
- **cchound** (F-08, F-09): Discloses 3+ years of personal use of Artlist and Epidemic Sound. Contains affiliate discount links for those platforms. No Envato affiliate links visible. Editorial stance favors dedicated music platforms over Envato for music-specific use.
- **FixThePhoto** (F-10, F-11): Discloses affiliate commission policy. Recommends Adobe Stock overall. Article appears approximately April 3, 2026.
- **StockPhotoSecrets** (F-12): Contains affiliate promotional content for both Shutterstock and Envato. Balanced tone in the passage captured.
- **Photutorial** (F-P07, F-P08): Discloses Envato partnership and coupon codes. Data-driven comparisons with specific library size figures. Balanced assessments with verdict statements.
- **Muksalcreative** (F-P09): Seller-focused comparison. Affiliate presence likely but unconfirmed from snippet.
- **Envato self-positioning** (F-P01 to F-P06): First-party marketing and help documentation. Claims are self-serving by nature. "Only" and "widest" claims are not independently verified.
- **Shutterstock press release** (F-P10): First-party acquirer statement. Figures (650k subscribers, 1.15M combined) are from a public company SEC filing and have regulatory accountability.
coverage_assessment:
- **Well-covered comparison targets:** Creative Market (SD-04), Adobe Stock (SD-05), Shutterstock (SD-06), dedicated music platforms (SD-08).
- **Partially covered:** Canva (SD-07) — one finding downgraded to F-X06 due to independent verification failure; comparison text available but not promoted to Part 1 or Part 2. Freepik (SD-09) — only a brief Capterra review found, downgraded to F-X04.
- **Not covered:** Reddit community discussion (SD-10) — complete absence. No Reddit content was retrievable during this research session.
- **Self-positioning coverage:** General differentiation (SD-01) and VoiceGen product comparisons (SD-02) are well-covered in Part 2. Payment model positioning (SD-03) is covered with a caveat about the age of the source.
tool_and_access_limitations:
- All envato.com and elements.envato.com URLs returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch. This is consistent across all subdomains (help center, learn blog, pricing, landing pages, about page, forums). All Envato self-positioning findings are therefore `blocked_url_index_verified`.
- photutorial.com blocks all crawlers via robots.txt. Content verified from search snippets only.
- muksalcreative.com returned HTTP 415 (Unsupported Media Type). Content verified from search result text.
- Reddit returned no results across all search strategies attempted (Google `site:reddit.com`, direct URL access, keyword variations). This may reflect current search index limitations rather than absence of relevant Reddit content.
- Quora is blocked by robots.txt site-wide; no full page content retrievable.
qa_checklist_applied_per_finding: Each finding was checked against: (1) Envato named explicitly ✓, (2) one positioning statement per finding ✓, (3) verbatim snippet is continuous passage ✓, (4) "What" field does not add comparisons absent from snippet ✓, (5) no cross-source synthesis ✓, (6) not a pure feature list / seller complaint / buyer review / generic listicle / affiliate roundup ✓, (7) source_type mapped to allowed enum ✓, (8) verification_status reflects actual access method ✓, (9) date captured where visible ✓, (10) affiliate disclosures noted ✓, (11) qualifiers preserved (platforms named, dimension, numbers, stance) ✓.
